source.authority: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
source.text: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller restriction of processing where one of the following applies: (a) the accuracy of the personal data is contested by the data subject; (b) the processing is unlawful and the data subject opposes the erasure and requests restriction instead; (c) the controller no longer needs the data but the data subject requires them for legal claims; (d) the data subject has objected pursuant to Article 21(1) pending verification.
